metaDescription.en: Software Engineer with 10+ years across banking, telecom and consulting. Credit risk and scoring systems at Santander UK, plus modern AI-assisted engineering and custom LLM agents.

summary.en: Software Engineer with over 10 years of experience across banking, telecom and consulting, based in Madrid. Currently at Santander UK, working on credit risk and scoring systems and leading a small development team. Delivered one of Santander's earliest Machine Learning proofs of concept in risk decisioning in 2017–2018; since 2024, deep into modern AI-assisted engineering — daily use of Claude Code, GitHub Copilot and other AI tools, plus building custom LLM agents for engineering workflows.

en: Own credit risk and scoring models; drive improvements to risk processes and controls across retail and corporate banking.
Progressed from Software Developer to leading a small development team and advising technical architects on integration and security architecture decisions.
Built an AI-assisted internal dashboard for live case monitoring, replacing manual SQL queries with real-time visibility.
Use GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, Google Antigravity and Devin daily for development and custom CI/CD workflows on OpenShift.
Backend and API development for Inditex's Center of Excellence, including a Kafka + Apache Flink real-time monitoring dashboard providing alerting and traceability across internal and external APIs.
Architecture department. Delivered software engineering services on external client engagements, including the Santander Global Tech and Telefónica placements below.

Risk Department — delivered one of Santander's earliest Machine Learning proofs of concept, integrating predictive models into the risk decisioning workflow years before enterprise AI adoption became mainstream.
Developed an API exposing risk prediction functionality for sales and financial products.
Requirements analysis, architecture design and development, using Agile methodology.
Telco 3.0 project — implemented REST architecture in the customer retention system.
Requirements analysis and technical documentation, using Agile methodology.
